metaDescription: Order custom biodegradable lanyards for eco-friendly events. Perfect for trade shows and corporate giveaways.
introHtml: Custom biodegradable lanyards are the sustainable choice for events, conferences, and employee IDs. Made from materials like PLA or bamboo fiber, these lanyards break down naturally after disposal, reducing plastic waste. Ideal for eco-conscious brands, they can be screen printed or debossed with your logo. Choose from eco-friendly attachments like recycled clips or bamboo breakaways to complete the look.
heroAltText: Custom biodegradable lanyards with screen-printed logo and bamboo breakaway clip on a wooden desk
